Container.Name: x.erp
Container.Overview: x.erp is a lightweight, free and open-source (AGPL-3.0) inventory and ERP system for small shops and small businesses: products with barcodes and multiple units, purchase and sales orders, returns, payments, multi-warehouse stock with transfers and stock taking, low-stock alerts, finance records, reports and staff accounts with permissions. Works in desktop and mobile browsers; all data stays in one SQLite database on your server. The user interface is in Simplified Chinese.[br][br]免费开源的进销存系统：商品、采购、销售、退货、收付款、多仓库库存、财务报表、员工权限。[br][br]First login: admin / admin123 (or the password set in XERP_ADMIN_PASSWORD on first start). Change it after logging in.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, daily automatic backups and logs

Config.Name: Initial admin password
Config.Description: Password of the admin account on the first start (at least 6 characters). Leave empty for admin123. Ignored after the first start.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for document dates and the daily backup
